short_scenes.card: 9 V, τ = 1 s, from 0: time to 5 V?
short_scenes.narration: A capacitor charges towards nine volts with a time constant of one second. When does it reach five volts? Pause and try it!

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Set five equals nine times one minus e to the minus t. Then e to the minus t is four ninths, and t is about zero point eight one seconds.
